description: Bihar partners with Google for Education to provide free AI training to teachers across 84 government technical institutions.
body_lead: Patna: The Bihar government has launched an initiative with Google for Education to strengthen artificial intelligence (AI) skills and digital teaching practices across the state’s government technical institutions. The programme will provide free AI training and access to Google Workspace facilities for teachers and faculty members. The initiative follows an agreement between the Department of Science, Technology and Technical Education, Government of Bihar, and Google for Education.
